== virtualUSB

- Fixed an issue where the virtualUSB desktop app showed an enabled *Disconnect* button for a device retained in the Kobiton Portal. Selecting it returned an error instead of disconnecting the device.
- A device retained or used in the Kobiton Portal now shows *Connect*. The button is enabled when you hold the device and disabled when another user holds it.
- *Disconnect* now appears only for devices connected through virtualUSB on your computer, including devices connected with the virtualUSB CLI.
- To connect a device you already hold in the Kobiton Portal, release it in the Portal first, then select *Connect* in virtualUSB.
